Officer's narrative
On arrival at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I found a rear-end collision between two vehicles. Driver 2 stated
that the trailing vehicle, operated by Driver 1, failed to stop in time and struck the rear of the vehicle ahead. Driver 1
confirmed the impact and said the lead vehicle slowed abruptly. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the
rear of the lead vehicle and the front of the trailing vehicle, and the other driver's account matches what the
photographs show. Several witnesses described the collision in the same way. A passenger in the lead vehicle
reported a knee injury, and that injury fits the kind and force of an impact of this nature. However, witnesses and I
both observed that the passenger was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred, which conflicts with the
passenger's account. It is unclear whether all of the damage to the lead vehicle resulted from this collision. No eralier
damage to either vehicle is known to me. Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the lead vehicle.
